item.title: Binding mechanisms dictate distinct interactions of iron oxides with nanoplastics under structural feature constraints
item.content:encoded:
Communications Earth & Environment, Published online: 09 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43247-026-04027-4

Ferrihydrite bound nanoplastics fastest while goethite retained the highest, most robust capacity; nanoplastic aging reduced binding, with surface attachment and pore entrapment driving differences, according to kinetic and mechanistic comparisons of iron oxides and nanoplastics.
